verdict.rationale: AuthKit docs list social sign-in as a built-in method ('Sign in to your app with Microsoft, Google, and more'). Pricing says social login comes 'all from one integration' alongside a customizable hosted UI, and SSO works with any SAML or OIDC IdP. This points to configuration-driven provider support rather than custom code. A community user did report a Slack OAuth option advertised on the signup page that was not available during setup, which hints the provider list may be narrower than implied. missing for 10: an explicit list showing how broad the social provider catalog is, documentation of dashboard-based configuration for social providers, independent hands-on corroboration.
